title: Bounded DNF representation
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every function $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, there is a DNF representation of $f$ with at most $2^n$ terms and width at most $n$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued Boolean function on $\{−1,1\}^n$
